concept: EFS: shared POSIX file system for many Linux instances across AZs
tests: Choosing storage for hundreds of Linux instances across multiple AZs accessing shared files concurrently.
expected: Amazon EFS — managed multi-AZ NFS, mounted by many Linux instances at once, POSIX semantics. Triggers: "hundreds of Linux instances", "multiple AZs", "same files concurrently", "POSIX".
why_not: EBS is tied to one AZ and (except io1/io2 Multi-Attach within one AZ) to one instance; FSx for Windows is SMB for Windows; instance store is ephemeral and local.
